mapper.select: SELECT ID AS PET_ID, MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, NAME AS PET_NAME, TYPE AS PET_TYPE, SPECIES, GENDER, AGE, WEIGHT FROM PET WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PET ( MEMBER_ID, NAME, TYPE, SPECIES, GENDER, AGE, WEIGHT, CREATED ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{petName}, #{petType}, #{petSpecies, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{petGender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{petAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{petWeight, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE )
